'''''Dantin's Folly''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that belonged to the [[Rebel privateer]] [[Chaeloe Dantin]]. It saw service throughout her work with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
